rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for a group or political motto, and it is also used for advertising slogans in speech.

example.english: This slogan represents our organization’s ideals.
example.traditional: 呢句口號代表我哋個組織嘅理念。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 hau2 hou6 doi6 biu2 ngo5 dei6 go3 zou2 zik1 ge3 lei5 nim6

rows.note: Use this more formal term for an advertising slogan, especially one displayed in writing or on a sign, rather than for an ordinary group motto.

example.english: This advertising slogan is printed on a bus-stop sign.
example.traditional: 呢個廣告標語印咗喺巴士站牌上。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 biu1 jyu5 jan3 zo2 hai2 baa1 si2 zaam6 paai4 soeng6
